how_to_apply: Read the detailed notification and instructions available on the website carefully.
Open the online application form and fill in accurate details of educational qualification, age, and domicile/residence.
Upload the required documents, including the Domicile Certificate and educational certificates.
Upload your recent photograph and signature in the specified format and size.
Pay the non-refundable examination fee of Rs. 600/- through the online payment mode. Note that payment status may take 24 to 48 hours to update.

Recheck all details filled in the form; if information is complete and correct, click "Save & Continue". Correct any wrong details before final submission, since details cannot be changed once the form is submitted.
Click "Submit" after uploading the photograph and signature and completing all sections of the form.
Click "Submit my Form" to finally submit the application after confirming that all details and the declaration are correct.
Note down the Form ID and Mobile Number, and take a printout of the acknowledgement/receipt for future reference.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted through the official website will be accepted; applications received through any other mode will not be considered. Any recommendation, pressure tactics, or malpractice by a candidate will lead to disqualification. The admit card will be made available only on the official website during the specified period and will not be sent by post; candidates must download and carry it to the exam along with a valid original photo ID. The written examination will be held in Sindhudurg district; the exact exam centre will be mentioned on the admit card. Candidates must keep visiting the official website regularly for updates during the recruitment process. The bank/recruiting authority reserves the right to change the recruitment conditions or to cancel the recruitment process, in part or in full, at any stage. For queries regarding the online application, candidates may contact the helpdesk email or the mobile number provided on the website.

content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed at least the 12th standard (HSC) examination from a recognised board. Minimum age: 21 years Maximum age: 40 years Eligible candidates must be born between 30/08/1986 and 30/08/2005 (both dates inclusive). A valid Domicile Certificate issued by a competent authority must be uploaded along with the educational qualification documents at the time of application. Applications will not be considered without this certificate. Candidates should be physically capable and fit to carry out the physical duties associated with the Shipai post.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following ready as scanned copies before starting the online application: Recent passport-size photograph (JPEG format, up to 20 KB, size 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm, front-facing with the face covering about 75% of the photo) Signature (JPEG format, up to 20 KB, size 2.5 cm x 1.5 cm, signed with a bold-point pen on plain white paper) Domicile Certificate proving residence in Sindhudurg district Educational qualification certificates (12th pass certificate and mark sheet) Valid identity proof for the exam, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, or Passport, along with the admit card
